title: Wire MCP stdio server

context.summary: Replace the MCP stdio placeholder with a runnable MCP SDK server that exposes Mindory tools over the HTTP API boundary.
context.background: TASK-21 and TASK-22 completed the HTTP job and memory/context surfaces. MCP now needs to be a real stdio server for agent clients without bypassing API authorization or persistence boundaries.

in: Implement stdio transport using the MCP SDK server and StdioServerTransport.
Register all Mindory tools through tools/list and tools/call handlers over the existing HTTP API client.
Expose a runnable MCP package start/bin entrypoint.
Update docs and validation scripts for real stdio behavior.
out: Add direct database, Redis, storage or vector access from MCP.
Add resources/prompts beyond the MVP tool list.
Add OAuth or token management through MCP.

acceptance_criteria: runMindoryMcpStdio creates an MCP SDK Server with tool capabilities.
StdioServerTransport is connected to the SDK server.
tools/list returns all Mindory tool definitions.
tools/call delegates to MindoryMcpToolRegistry and returns text content.
MCP code continues to call only the HTTP API client and does not import database, queue, storage or vector internals.
Docs and validations describe the runnable stdio server.

manual_checks: Confirm stdio placeholder error was removed.
Confirm MCP tool execution uses HTTP API client only.
Confirm no DB/Redis/storage/vector imports exist in apps/mcp.

risks: The stdio server can be structurally validated, but complete tool execution still requires a running API and bearer token.
MCP SDK APIs can change; package version is locked in pnpm-lock.yaml for reproducibility.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to accepted or done.
Branch can be merged into master without unrelated changes.
